references.title: limerence
references.rights_note: APA Dictionary defines an intense romantic/sexual desire with strong concern for the other's reactions. Card wording is further bounded by contemporary scholarly research on reciprocation uncertainty and intrusive preoccupation.
references.citation_display: American Psychological Association. (2018). limerence. APA Dictionary of Psychology.

references.title: Limerence, Hidden Obsession, Fixation, and Rumination: A Scoping Review of Human Behaviour
references.publisher_or_container: Journal of Police and Criminal Psychology
references.rights_note: Scoping review defines limerence through obsessive attachment, overwhelming longing for attention, intrusive thoughts, hope/uncertainty around reciprocation, and distinguishes it from a crush or ordinary being in love.
references.citation_display: Harper, C., & Lievesley, D. (2024). Limerence, Hidden Obsession, Fixation, and Rumination: A Scoping Review of Human Behaviour. Journal of Police and Criminal Psychology. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11896-024-09674-x

references.title: compersion
references.rights_note: Dictionary entry defines happiness caused by another's happiness, especially a romantic/sexual partner interacting positively with another partner. Scholarly evidence fixes the narrower CNM use for this card.
